description:
OpenNavBar is an open-source and customizable navigation bar for Android.
Features:
• Background and button custom colors
• Button padding and size
• Swap back and recents buttons
• Swap back and recents in landscape
• Use custom button images with masking support
• Auto-hide navbar
• Togglable haptic feedback
• Long press / slide actions:
• All Android versions: None, Back, Home, Recent Apps, Notifications, Quick Settings, Power Menu, Hide Navbar
• Android 9+: Lock Screen, Take Screenshot
• Android 12+: All Apps Drawer
• Android 15+: Media Play/Pause, System Menu
Technical advantages:
• Low size (approx. 4MB), minimal dependencies
• No data collection
